blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hate speech has become increasingly prevalent on social media, raising concerns about its detection, interpretation, and moderation. Persian, a relatively low-resource language, lacks sufficient annotated data and computational resources for fine-grained hate speech analysis. In this study, we introduce a fine-grained, multi-hop benchmark for explainable Persian hate speech analysis, covering content triage, target identification, hate tactic and moral foundation analysis, textual evidence extraction, harmful narrative inference, and severity assessment. By evaluating state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs), we find that performance generally declines as tasks require more fine-grained semantic and inferential reasoning. Proprietary models generally outperform open-weight models, while reasoning-oriented models show no consistent advantage. Incorporating intermediate reasoning steps substantially improves severity prediction compared with one-shot assessment. Our analysis further reveals that Incitement to Violence or Harm is most strongly associated with higher severity, while political-affiliation targets are particularly associated with subversion-based moral framing. Overall, this work provides insights into LLM-based hate speech analysis and supports more accountable moderation of Persian-language social media. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/kalhorghazal/From-Triage-to-Impact.
blocks.zh: 仇恨言论在社交媒体上越来越普遍, 波斯语是一种相对资源较少的语言,缺乏足够的附加注释的数据和计算资源来进行精细的仇恨言论分析. 在这项研究中,我们引入了一个精细的多跳基准,用于解释波斯仇恨言论分析,涵盖内容分类,目标识别,仇恨战术和道德基础分析,文字证据提取,有害的叙事推论,以及严重程度评估. 通过评价最先进的大型语言模型(LLMs),我们发现性能一般会下降,因为任务需要更精细的语义和推论推理. 专有模型一般优于开放量级模型,而以推理为导向的模型则没有表现出一致的优势. 与一弹一弹的评估相比,采用中间推理步骤大大改进了严重程度预测。 我们的分析还表明,煽动暴力或伤害与更严重的行为最密切相关,而政治关联目标则与颠覆性道德框架特别相关。 总体而言,这项工作为基于LLM的仇恨言论分析提供了洞察力,并支持波斯语社交媒体更加负责的节制. 该基准可在https://github.com/kalhorghazal/From-Triage-to-Impact上公开查阅。

blocks.zh: 图 1:管道说明多跳推理步骤,人验证,和LLM评价.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: From the advent of online social media, hate speech 1 1 1 This paper includes potentially offensive or violent hate speech examples. has become an increasingly prevalent and harmful behavior among users of these platforms. It expresses hatred toward a targeted group or seeks to demean or insult its members, undermining their dignity, inclusion, and well-being Davidson et al. (2017) ; Waldron (2012) . The Persian language is used across multiple geopolitical contexts, from Iran to the diaspora, and is associated with real-world stakes including migration tensions, religious marginalization, and gender and political polarization, making it a high-impact language for NLP-based content moderation Bokaei et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 从网络社交媒体的到来,仇恨言论 1 1 本文包含了潜在的冒犯性或暴力性的仇恨言论实例. 这些平台的用户越来越普遍和有害的行为。 它表达对目标群体的仇恨,或试图贬低或侮辱其成员,损害其尊严、包容和Davidson等人的福祉(2017年);Waldron(2012)。 波斯语在从伊朗到侨民的多种地缘政治背景下使用,与现实世界的利害关系有关,包括移徙紧张、宗教边缘化以及性别和政治两极分化,使其成为基于NLP的内容节制Bokaei等人(2025年)的高影响语言。

blocks.en: Despite the societal importance of Persian hate speech, the language remains low-resource in this domain, as most existing hate speech detection systems are English-centric Trager et al. (2025) ; Tonneau et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2023) ; Poletto et al. (2021) . Persian-focused approaches often rely on black-box classification with binary or coarse-grained labels that lack explainability Kebriaei et al. (2024) ; Nazarizadeh et al. (2025) , or employ fragmented annotation schemes that capture only one or two aspects of the reasoning process, such as the target Mozafari et al. (2024) or the text span Delbari et al. (2024) . Thus, these approaches can identify whether content is hateful, but not how it is expressed, why it is framed as harmful, or what potential consequences it may entail. This limitation is particularly problematic because hate speech is often implicit, multi-layered, and morally framed, and cannot be reliably addressed using surface-level features alone Kim et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 尽管波斯仇恨言论具有社会重要性,但该语言在这一领域仍然资源不足,因为大多数现有的仇恨言论侦测系统都是以英语为中心的Trager等人(2025年);通诺等人(2024年);杨等人(2023年);波利托等人(2021年). 以波斯为焦点的方法往往依赖于黑盒分类,并带有缺乏可解释性的二进制或粗重标签克布里亚埃等(2024年);Nazarizadeh等(2025年),或采用只捕捉推理过程一到两个方面的零散注解方案,如目标Mozafari等(2024年)或文字横跨Delbari等(2024年). 因此,这些方法可以确定内容是否是可恨的,但不能确定内容是如何表达的,为什么被描述为有害的,或者它可能造成什么潜在后果。 这种限制尤其成问题,因为仇恨言论往往含蓄地、多层次地和在道德上陷害,不能仅用Kim等人(2022年)的地表特征来可靠地解决。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we propose an explainable multi-hop reasoning framework for hate speech detection in Persian. The sequential, human-interpretable framework supports a structured content-moderation process rather than relying on post-hoc explanations. Each hop builds on the previous one to reduce ambiguity and enable traceable and accountable decisions, capturing the underlying reasoning process by which humans identify, interpret, and assess hate speech.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了一个解释性的多跳推理框架,用于在波斯语中发现仇恨言论。 相继而来,人文可解释的框架支持结构化的内容-修改过程,而不是依赖后浩克的解释. 每一次行动都以前一次行动为基础,以减少含糊不清之处并促成可追溯和可问责的决定,抓住人类识别、解释和评估仇恨言论的基本推理过程。

blocks.en: Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) advances a pluralist view of morality grounded in multiple moral dimensions, including Care/Harm, Fairness/Cheating, Loyalty/Betrayal, Authority/Subversion, and Purity/Degradation Koleva et al. (2015) . Hate speech often draws on shared moral values and perceived moral violations to legitimize hostility toward targeted groups Hoover et al. (2019) . Given MFT’s demonstrated relevance to Persian discourse Atari et al. (2020) ; Nejat et al. (2015) , moral reasoning is crucial for understanding and detecting Persian hate speech.
blocks.zh: 道德基金会 理论(MFT)提出了基于多种道德层面的多元道德观,包括Care/Harm、Fairness/Cheating、Loyence/Betrayal、Authority/Subversion,以及Purity/Degradation Koleva等人(2015年)。 仇恨言论往往取自共同的道德价值观和被认为违反道德的行为,使对目标群体胡佛等人的敌意合法化(2019年)。 鉴于MFT对波斯人言论Atari等人(2020年)表现出了相关性;Nejat等人(2015年),道德推理对于理解和发现波斯人仇恨言论至关重要。

blocks.en: By incorporating MFT, we construct a 1,200-instance Persian hate speech dataset using a seven-hop reasoning framework: (1) initial content triage , (2) target identification , (3) hate speech tactic identification , (4) moral foundation analysis , (5) textual rationale extraction , (6) inference of the underlying harmful narrative , and (7) severity and potential impact assessment . Initial annotations are generated using Gemini 3.5 Flash, a state-of-the-art LLM in the Gemini family that has shown strong performance on Persian-language tasks, 2 2 2 https://mcinext-mizan-llm-leaderboard.hf.space/ and validated against independent human annotations.
blocks.zh: 通过纳入MFT,我们用7-hop的推理框架构建了1,200个波斯仇恨言论数据集:(1) 初始内容分类,(2) 目标识别,(3) 仇恨言论战术识别,(4) 道德基础分析,(5) 文字理由提取,(6) 基本有害叙述推论,以及(7) 严重程度和潜在影响评估。 初步说明是使用双子座3.5 Flash生成的,这是双子座家族中最先进的LLM,在波斯语任务上表现出了很强的性能,2 2 2 https://mcinext-mizan-llm-leaderboard.hf.space/,并用独立的人文说明验证.

blocks.en: Using our dataset, we evaluate eight state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight LLMs to investigate four questions: (1) how LLM performance changes as hate speech analysis progresses from initial triage to deeper reasoning; (2) how performance varies across proprietary versus open-weight and reasoning versus instruction-tuned models; (3) whether step-wise reasoning across Hops 1–6 improves severity prediction over one-shot prediction; and (4) which Persian hate speech tactics are most strongly associated with higher severity levels.
blocks.zh: 我们利用我们的数据集,评价了8个最先进的专有和开放量级的LLMs,以调查4个问题:(1)随着仇恨言论分析从最初的分解到更深的推理,LLM性能是如何变化的;(2)不同专有和开放量级和推理的性能如何相去甚远,而不同指令调整的模型如何相去甚远;(3)跨Hops 1–6的分步推理是否比一弹一弹的预测改进了严重程度预测;(4)波斯仇恨言论策略与更严重程度的关系最紧密.

blocks.en: Our findings reveal substantial variation in LLM performance across the multi-hop analysis of Persian hate speech. Performance generally declines as tasks require more fine-grained reasoning, with proprietary models generally outperforming open-weight models and the benefits of reasoning-oriented models varying across tasks. Incorporating intermediate analyses from Hops 1–6 substantially improves severity prediction over one-shot assessment, although the improvement varies considerably across models. Beyond model performance, Incitement to Violence or Harm shows the strongest association with higher severity, while political-affiliation targets show a particularly strong association with subversion-based moral framing. These findings highlight the challenges of reliable, interpretable LLM-based hate speech analysis and the value of modeling harmful discourse for social media moderation.
blocks.zh: 在波斯仇恨言论的多跳分析中, 性能一般会下降,因为任务需要更精细的推理,专有模型一般优于成绩的开量模型,以推理为导向的模型的效益因任务而异. 采用Hops 1-6的中间分析大大改进了对严重程度的预测,而不是一弹一发的评估,尽管各模型的改进差别很大。 除了模范表现外,煽动暴力或伤害还表现出更强烈的关联性,而政治附属目标则显示出与以颠覆为基础的道德框架的特别强烈关联性。 这些调查结果凸显出可靠、可解释的基于LLM的仇恨言论分析的挑战,以及为社交媒体节制而树立有害言论模型的价值。

blocks.en: 2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 2 基准建设

blocks.en: To construct our benchmark, we consider two major social media platforms: X and Instagram, which are prominent sources of hate speech among Persian-speaking users. We first review recent studies that collect and release Persian-language datasets from these platforms (Appendix A ). Since most existing datasets primarily focus on hate speech instances, we balance the data at the first hop (initial content triage) by manually collecting recent posts from X. Specifically, we retrieve posts using keywords extracted from our labeled data by querying Gemini 3.5 Flash. Figures 6 – 7 present example prompts used for extracting keywords associated with offensive language and dangerous speech. Overall, our dataset contains 348 instances collected from prior work and 852 instances collected in this study, resulting in 1,200 texts with 300 instances per initial content triage category. The following describes the collection and preprocessing procedure for the newly collected instances.
blocks.zh: 为了构建我们的基准,我们考虑两个主要的社交媒体平台: X和Instagram是波斯语使用者中仇恨言论的显著来源. 我们首先回顾最近收集并发布这些平台波斯语数据集的研究(附录A. 由于大多数现有数据集主要关注仇恨言论事件,因此我们通过人工收集X最近的文章来平衡第一跳(初始内容分解)的数据. 具体地说,我们通过查询双子座3.5 Flash,通过从我们标签数据中提取的关键词来检索帖子. 图6 - 7 本例提示用于提取与攻击性语言和危险言论有关的关键词。 总体而言,我们的数据集包含从以往工作收集的348个实例和本研究收集的852个实例,结果有1 200个文本,每个初始内容分类类别有300个实例。 以下介绍新收集实例的收集和预处理程序。

blocks.en: To collect the 852 additional instances introduced in this benchmark, we manually search X using queries of the following format: ("keyword") lang:fa -is:retweet -is:reply since:2026-02-28 . This filtering strategy ensures that the collected posts were published after the collection period of existing datasets, which were all obtained before 2026, thereby reducing potential overlap and capturing more recent patterns of online discourse. We then apply the annotation prompts described in the following section to verify whether each retrieved post belongs to the target triage categories; posts that do not satisfy the criteria are removed. Finally, we anonymize all texts by replacing user mentions with @username and URLs with www.link.com . The overall workflow of our dataset construction and evaluation process is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了收集本基准中引入的852个额外实例,我们使用下列格式的查询来手动搜索X:("关键词") lang:fa -is:retweet -is:reply since:2026-02-28. 这种过滤战略确保了所收集的帖子在收集现有数据集后公布,这些数据集都是在2026年之前获得的,从而减少潜在的重叠并捕捉到更近期的在线言论模式. 然后,我们采用下一节所描述的注释提示,以核实每个被检索的员额是否属于目标分类;不符合标准的员额被删除。 最后,我们用@username和www.link.com取代用户提及,从而对所有文本进行匿名。 图1说明了我们数据集建设和评价过程的总体工作流程。

blocks.en: To assign values for each hop to every text instance, we employ Gemini 3.5 Flash with a chain-of-thought prompting strategy. The model is provided with the definition of each hop and its corresponding output schema, as specified in Table 1 . To assess the quality of the automatically generated annotations, we randomly select a sample of 100 texts, stratified by the first-hop content-triage labels (25 texts per category) to ensure balanced representation across the four categories. Two native Persian-speaking annotators independently annotate these texts using the same prompt provided to the LLMs. We then measure inter-annotator agreement between the two human annotators and compare the human annotations with the Gemini-generated reference annotations.
blocks.zh: 为了给每个文本实例分配每个跳动的值,我们用双子座3.5 Flash 来使用一个思维链的提示策略. 如表1所示,该模型载有每个跳动的定义及其相应的输出方案。 为了评估自动生成的说明的质量,我们随机选择100个文本样本,由首跳内容分层标签分层(每类25个文本),以确保这4个类别的均衡代表性。 两名讲波斯语的当地注释员使用提供给法学硕士的同样提示对这些文本进行独立注释。 然后,我们衡量两个人类注释者之间的注释者协议,并将人类注释同双子座生成的参考说明进行比较.

blocks.en: The inter-annotator agreement results indicate varying levels of agreement across annotation tasks and output types. Agreement is higher for initial content triage and severity classification, while it varies across categorical and multi-label annotations. Agreement is lower for tasks requiring open-ended judgments, particularly narrative inference and impact assessment. These results suggest that agreement depends on the annotation dimension and that text-based reasoning tasks involve greater interpretive variability among annotators. Complete inter-annotator agreement results, including the task-specific metrics used for each hop, are reported in Table 6 (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 说明人之间的协议结果表明,在说明任务和产出类型方面,同意的程度各不相同。 初步内容分类和严重程度分类的一致程度较高,但明确和多标签说明的一致程度不同。 对于需要作出开放式判断的任务,特别是叙述性推论和影响评估,协议较低。 这些结果表明,协议取决于注释方面,基于文本的推理任务涉及说明者之间更大的解释可变性。 表6(附录C)汇报了完整的公证员协议结果,包括每个跳跃所使用的具体任务指标。

blocks.en: Disagreements are resolved by the first author to produce the gold labels for each hop. We compare Gemini’s outputs with these gold labels using the same metrics as in the LLM evaluation described in the following sections. Table 7 (Appendix C ) presents the Human–LLM alignment results. We observe high alignment for most closed-ended tasks, particularly target group identification and hate tactic and moral foundation detection. Alignment is lower for tasks involving open-ended text generation, especially narrative inference and potential impact assessment. This is expected, as automatic metrics may not fully capture semantic similarity, particularly in a low-resource language such as Persian. Despite these limitations, the results indicate that Gemini’s annotations are sufficiently aligned with the gold labels to serve as reference annotations for our analyses.
blocks.zh: 分歧由第一作者解决,为每跳制作出金牌. 我们用与下文所述LLM评价相同的度量标准,将双子公司的产出与这些金牌进行比较。 表7(附录C)列出了Human-LLM调整结果。 我们看到大多数封闭式任务高度一致,特别是目标群体的识别以及仇恨战术和道德基础的发现。 对涉及开放式文本生成,特别是叙述性推论和潜在影响评估的任务,调整程度较低。 这一点是预料之中的,因为自动度量法可能无法完全捕捉到语义相似性,特别是在波斯等低资源语言中. 尽管有这些限制,结果表明双子座的说明与金色标签充分一致,可作为我们分析的参考说明。

blocks.en: Table 1: Definitions of the reasoning hops and their corresponding output schemas.
blocks.zh: 表1:推理跳跃及其相应的输出计划的定义.

blocks.en: Table 2: Categories for targeted groups and identity bases used in the study.
blocks.zh: 表2:研究中使用的目标群体和身份基础的类别。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate eight state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs on our benchmark: Grok 4.6, GPT-5.2, o3, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 as proprietary models, and DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, Qwen3 30B A3B Thinking 2507, and Qwen3 30B A3B Instruct 2507 as open-weight models. This set enables comparisons across model access types and reasoning capabilities, with all models officially supporting Persian.
blocks.zh: 我们以我们的基准评价了8种最先进的多语言法学硕士:Grok 4.6,GPT-5.2,o3和Claude Sonnet 4.6作为专有模型;DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, Qune3 30B A3B Thinking 2507, Qune3 30B A3B 教程2507作为开放量级模型. 这个集可以比较模型访问类型和推理能力,所有模型都正式支持波斯语.

blocks.en: We use API calls for all models. All prompts use one-shot prompting, with the multi-hop annotation prompt additionally employing a chain-of-thought strategy. We set the temperature to 0 and top- p p to 1, prioritizing accuracy over creativity. Each prompt is executed independently. Prompt templates and their English translations are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们使用API呼叫所有模型. 所有提示都使用一发提示,而多跳提示的提示还采用了一连串的思维策略. 我们把温度设定为0,最高点为p到1, 确定精度高于创造力。 每个提示都是独立执行的. 附录D提供了快速模板及其英文译文。

blocks.en: 4 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4. 主要结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 示范评价

blocks.en: As this is a single-label multiclass classification task with class-balanced reference data, we report macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1. As shown in Table 3 , all proprietary models outperform the open-weight models, among which DeepSeek R1 performs best. Reasoning variants generally outperform their paired instruct variants, primarily through higher recall with little loss in precision. Overall, initial Persian hate-speech triage varies across model families and inference paradigms, with proprietary models leading and reasoning offering a recall advantage among paired open-weight models.
blocks.zh: 由于这是单标签的多类分类任务,并有分类平衡的参考数据,我们报告宏观平均精确度、回顾和F1。 如表3所示,所有专有模型都超过了开量模型,其中DeepSeek R1表现最好. 理性变体一般比其成对指示变体的性能要好,主要通过更高的回想,而精度几乎没有损失. 总体而言,最初的波斯仇恨言论分类因模范家庭和推论范式而异,专有模式主导和推理为配对的开量模型提供了召回优势.

blocks.en: For Hops 2–6, we restrict the evaluation to instances that are annotated as Harmful in the reference labels. This filtering excludes Not Harmful cases and ensures that subsequent hops assess each model’s ability to identify specific hate-speech attributes on a common gold-standard set of harmful instances, making the results comparable.
blocks.zh: 对于Hops 2–6, 我们仅限于在参考标签中标注为有害的事例。 这种过滤排除了非有害案例,并确保随后的跳跃评估每个模型在一套共同的金本位有害事件上识别具体的仇恨言论属性的能力,使结果具有可比性。

blocks.en: Table 3: LLM performance across Hops 1–6 of the multi-hop Persian hate-speech reasoning benchmark. All metrics are reported on a 0–100 scale, with task-appropriate evaluation metrics used for each hop. Higher values indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 表3:多跳波斯仇恨言论推理基准中跨Hops 1-6的LLM性能. 所有衡量标准都按0-100的比例报告,每一次都使用适合任务的评价指标。 较高的数值表明表现较好。

blocks.en: To assess whether LLMs can identify the target of hate speech and the identity dimension under attack, we report micro- and macro-averaged F1 for the Targeted Group and Basis of Identity tasks. Micro F1 captures overall performance, while macro F1 gives equal weight to each category and is more sensitive to performance on less frequent categories. Table 3 shows that all proprietary models outperform the open-weight models. The larger micro–macro gaps for open-weight models suggest greater difficulty identifying less frequent categories among the 12 targeted groups (Table 2 ). DeepSeek R1 performs best among open-weight models in macro F1. Both DeepSeek R1 and Qwen3 Think also achieve higher macro F1 than their paired instruct variants, with only modest differences in micro F1, suggesting that reasoning may improve coverage of less frequent categories.
blocks.zh: 为了评估LLMS是否能够识别被攻击的仇恨言论的目标和身份层面,我们报告针对群体和身份基础任务的微观和宏观平均F1。 micro F1捕捉总体性能,而macro F1则对每个类别给予同等的分量,对较少的类别上的性能较为敏感. 表3显示,所有专有模型都超过了开放量级模型。 开放重量模型的较大的微观-宏观差距表明,更难在12个目标群体中确定不太频繁的类别(表2)。 DeepSeek R1 在宏的开量模型中表现最好 F1. DeepSeek R1和Quen3两个 思考还实现了比它们成对指示变体更高的宏F1,在微观F1中只有微小的区别,说明推理可以提高频率较低的类别的覆盖范围.

blocks.en: For Basis of Identity detection, proprietary models again outperform open-weight models on both metrics. The substantial micro–macro gaps indicate continued difficulty identifying less frequent categories among the 14 identity bases (Table 2 ). The effect of reasoning is task-dependent: Qwen3 Think achieves higher macro but lower micro F1 than Qwen3 Instruct, while DeepSeek R1 performs similarly to DeepSeek V3 in micro F1 and slightly better in macro F1. Overall, performance varies across model families and inference paradigms, with the largest differences emerging in coverage of less frequent categories.
blocks.zh: 就身份检测基础而言,专有模型再次超过了两个度量衡上的开放式模型。 实质性的微观-宏观差距表明,在14个身份基础中确定较少的类别仍有困难(表2)。 推理的效果取决于任务: Quen3 思考比Qune3 Instruct实现更高的宏但更低的微F1,而DeepSeek R1在微F1中表现与DeepSeek V3相似,在宏F1中稍好一些. 总体而言,各模范家庭和推论范式的表现各不相同,在涵盖频率较低的类别方面出现了最大的差异。

blocks.en: As this is a multi-label classification task, we report micro- and macro-averaged F1 and adapted F1 Trager et al. (2025) , which measures whether a model identifies at least one hate tactic present in the text. As shown in Table 3 , there is a substantial gap between micro and macro F1 score, which indicates that models perform better on frequent hate tactics than on less frequent ones, particularly among open-weight models.
blocks.zh: 由于这是一个多标签分类任务,我们报告微观和宏观平均F1, 并改编F1 Trager等人(2025年), 如表3所示,在微观和宏观F1得分之间存在巨大差距,这表明模型在频繁的仇恨战术上表现优于较少的战术上表现优异,特别是在开放量级模型中.

blocks.en: The effect of reasoning is mixed: DeepSeek R1 achieves lower micro and macro F1 than DeepSeek V3, while Qwen3 Think outperforms Qwen3 Instruct on both metrics, particularly macro F1. Thus, reasoning may improve coverage of less frequent hate tactics in some models. Adapted F1 scores are generally high, indicating that most models identify at least one applicable hate tactic once harmful content has been established.
blocks.zh: 推理的效果有好有坏: DeepSeek R1 实现了比 DeepSeek V3 更低的微观和宏观 F1 , 而 Quen3 则 考虑成绩 Quen3 指示两个度量,特别是宏 F1. 因此,推理可以改进某些模式对较少的仇恨策略的涵盖。 改编后F1的分数一般都很高,表明大多数模型在有害内容确定后至少确定一种可适用的仇恨战术.

blocks.en: We next examine whether models can move beyond the hate tactics identified in Hop 3 to recognize the underlying moral foundations of harmful content. As this is a multi-label classification task, we report micro- and macro-averaged F1 and adapted F1. As illustrated in Table 3 , compared with Hop 3, micro F1 and adapted F1 decrease for every model, indicating that moral foundation identification is more challenging overall. However, macro F1 increases for DeepSeek V3 and Qwen3 Instruct, suggesting that the difficulty of identifying less frequent categories varies across models.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们审查模式是否能够超越Hop 3中所确定的仇恨策略,承认有害内容的基本道德基础。 由于这是一个多标签分类任务,我们报告微观和宏观平均F1和被改造的F1. 如表3所示,与Hop 3相比,每个模型的小型F1和经过调整的F1下降,表明道德基础识别总体上更具挑战性。 然而,对于DeepSeek V3和Qune3 Instructionct来说,宏F1的增量表明,不同模型中识别频率较低类别的难度不同.

blocks.en: The advantage of proprietary models is less uniform than in Hop 3: although Grok performs best overall, DeepSeek V3 achieves a higher macro F1 than GPT-5.2, indicating competitive coverage of less frequent moral foundations. The effect of reasoning is also mixed: DeepSeek R1 slightly outperforms DeepSeek V3 in micro F1 but performs substantially worse in macro F1, while Qwen3 Think achieves a slightly lower micro F1 than Qwen3 Instruct, which has the higher macro F1. Thus, reasoning provides no consistent advantage for moral foundation identification. Adapted F1 remains high (71.2–89.8%), indicating that most models identify at least one relevant moral foundation even when they struggle to identify the full set of applicable foundations.
blocks.zh: 专有模式的优势不如Hop 3:虽然格罗克整体表现最好,但DeepSeek V3实现了比GPT-5.2更高的宏F1,表明道德基础较少的竞争性覆盖. 推理的效果也好坏参半: DeepSeek R1在微F1中略微超过DeepSeek V3,但在宏F1中表现严重更差;而Qune3 思维比Quen3 Instruct稍低一点的微分F1,它具有较高的宏F1. 因此,推理不能为道德基础的确定提供一贯的优势。 适应的F1仍然很高(71.2-89.8%),这表明大多数模型至少确定一个相关的道德基础,即使它们努力确定一整套适用的基金会。

blocks.en: To assess whether LLMs can extract textual evidence supporting the target, tactic, and moral foundation analyses, we measure lexical overlap using Jaccard similarity Jaccard (1901) and semantic similarity using BERTScore Zhang et al. (2019) . We use hazm 3 3 3 https://github.com/roshan-research/hazm for Persian tokenization and HooshvareLab/bert-base-parsbert-uncased , pretrained on Persian Farahani et al. (2021) , for BERTScore. As each rationale may contain multiple textual spans, we report average pairwise and maximum similarity across reference spans, capturing overall alignment and the strongest individual match, respectively. Table 3 presents the results for the three rationale types.
blocks.zh: 为了评估LLMS是否能够提取支持目标,战术,道德基础分析的文字证据,我们用Jacard相似性Jacard(1901年)和用BERTScore Zhang等人(2019年)来测量词典重叠. 我们使用hazm 3 3 3 https://github.com/roshan-research/hazm来表示波斯的象征意义, 由于每个理由可能包含多个文字跨度,我们报告平均对等和最大程度的跨参考跨度相似,分别记录总体对齐和最强的个人对齐。 表3列出三种理由类别的结果。

blocks.en: Tactic rationales achieve the highest similarity, followed by target rationales, while moral rationales are the most difficult to reproduce. This suggests that models more readily identify evidence associated with explicit hate tactics than evidence supporting more abstract moral foundations. BERTScore consistently exceeds Jaccard similarity, indicating that generated rationales often preserve semantic content despite lexical differences. Maximum similarity also consistently exceeds average similarity, suggesting that models can identify individual matching evidence spans even when their overall rationales differ from the references.
blocks.zh: 战术原理实现最高的相似性,其次是目标原理,而道德原理最难被再生. 这表明模型比支持更抽象的道德基础的证据更容易识别与明显的仇恨策略相关的证据. 比尔特斯分数持续超过 Jaccard相似性,表示产生的原理尽管有法理上的差异,但往往保留了语义上的内容. 最大相似性也始终超过平均相似性,这表明模型即使其总体原理与参考文献不同,也可以确定单个匹配证据跨度.

blocks.en: Proprietary models show the clearest advantage on moral rationales, while open-weight models such as DeepSeek R1 and V3 achieve relatively competitive scores on target and tactic rationales. Reasoning provides no uniform advantage across rationale types and model families, suggesting that its benefits in some classification hops do not necessarily transfer to textual evidence generation.
blocks.zh: 专有模式在道德原理上展现出最明显的优势,而DeepSeek R1和V3等开放量级模式则在目标和战术原理上获得相对有竞争力的分数. 理性在原理类型和模型家族之间没有统一的优势,说明它在某些分类跳出中的好处并不一定会转移到文字证据生成上.

blocks.en: To evaluate the similarity between LLM-generated and reference harmful narratives, we compute three metrics for each reference–generation pair: BERTScore F1 Zhang et al. (2019) with HooshvareLab/bert-base-parsbert-uncased for token-level semantic similarity, cosine similarity Reimers and Gurevych (2019) using paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2 for embedding-space similarity, and chrF++ Popović (2017) for character n n -gram overlap with word-order information. We report mean scores across all pairs in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 为了评价LLM生成的和参考有害的叙述的相似性,我们计算出每个参考-生成对的3个指标:BERTScore F1 张等 (2019年)与HooshvareLab/bert-base-parsbert-uncased为符号级语义相近性,同心相近性Reimers和Gurevich (2019年)使用配音-多语言-mpnet-base-v2为嵌入-空间相近性,并使用chrF++ Popović (2017),用于字符n-克与单词顺序信息的重叠. 我们在表3中报告所有对子的得分

blocks.en: Proprietary models generally outperform open-weight models, although DeepSeek R1 and V3 achieve competitive semantic similarity scores. DeepSeek R1 attains a BERTScore F1 close to GPT-5.2 despite lower cosine similarity. Across all models, chrF++ scores are considerably lower than semantic similarity scores, indicating substantial character-level differences despite semantic overlap.
blocks.zh: 专有模式一般优于开放量级模式,尽管DeepSeek R1和V3实现了竞争性语义相似分数. DeepSeek R1获得一个接近于GPT-5.2的BERTScore F1,尽管同心弦相似度较低. 在所有模型中,chrF++的分数都大大低于语义相似性分数,表明尽管语义重叠,但字符级差异很大.

blocks.en: The comparison between reasoning and instruct variants reveals different patterns across model families. DeepSeek R1 outperforms DeepSeek V3 on all three metrics, whereas Qwen3 Think outperforms Qwen3 Instruct only on BERTScore F1, with lower cosine similarity and chrF++ scores. Thus, reasoning variants do not consistently improve similarity across model families and evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 推理和指示变体的比较揭示了各模范家庭的不同模式. 深搜索 R1 超标 所有三个度量的深搜索 V3, 而 Quen3 考虑成绩 Quen3 仅在 BERTScore F1 上指示,下同位素相似度和 chrF++ 分数. 因此,各种推理变量无法始终如一地改善示范家庭和评价指标之间的相似性。

blocks.en: We assess whether LLMs can determine the severity of harmful content and articulate its potential impact. For severity assessment, we calculate macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 for this single-label, multi-class classification task. Because the four severity levels are ordinal (Low, Medium, High, Severe), we additionally report weighted Cohen’s ( κ \kappa ) Cohen (1968) , excluding instances without a valid severity label from this metric but retaining them for the others. We also conduct a one-shot ablation in which models predict severity directly from the original text without access to the intermediate outputs from Hops 1–6, to examine their contribution to severity prediction (prompt template in Figure 8 ). Table 4 reports results for both settings.
blocks.zh: 我们评估LLMS是否能够确定有害内容的严重性并阐明其潜在影响。 对于严重程度评估,我们计算出宏观平均精度,回想,以及F1这个单标签多类分类任务. 因为四个重度水平是平分的(低、中、高、重),我们额外报告Chohen的加权值(磅) 科恩(1968年),将没有有效严重程度标签的情况排除在这一衡量标准之外,但保留给其他情况。 我们还进行了一发一发的试射,其中模型直接从原始文本中预测严重程度,而无法获得Hops 1-6的中间输出,以检查其对严重程度预测的贡献(图8中的即时模板)。 表4报告两种设置的结果。

blocks.en: Multi-hop analysis improves macro F1 for five models (DeepSeek V3, DeepSeek R1, GPT-5.2, Qwen3 Instruct, and Sonnet), but decreases it for Grok, o3, and Qwen3 Think. However, weighted Cohen’s ( κ \kappa ) is higher in the multi-hop setting for every model, suggesting better ordinal agreement on instances with valid predictions. These findings provide qualified support for RQ3: intermediate analyses improve ordinal agreement consistently but do not improve macro F1 for all models. The comparison between proprietary and open-weight models reveals no uniform advantage across settings, and reasoning variants do not consistently outperform their paired instruct variants: DeepSeek R1 underperforms DeepSeek V3 in macro F1 in both settings, while Qwen3 Think performs worse than Qwen3 Instruct in the multi-hop setting but better in the one-shot ablation.
blocks.zh: 多跳分析改进了5个型号(DeepSeek V3, DeepSeek R1, GPT-5.2, Qune3 Instruct, 和 Sonnet)的宏F1,但Grok, o3, 和 Qune3 Think 则减少. 然而,每个模型的多跳设置中的加权Cohen(ob \kappa )要高一些,这说明在有有效预测的情况下,可以达成更好的平面一致。 这些结论为RQ3提供了限定性支持:中间分析持续地改进了平面协议,但并没有改善所有模型的宏F1. 专利模型和开放量模型的比较显示,不同设置之间没有统一的优势,推理变体的性能并不一贯地超过其配对指示变体: 深搜索 R1 绩效不足 宏 F1 中的深搜索 V3, 而 Quen3 思考表现比Quen3在多跳的设定中更糟糕,但在一发的发烧中更好.

blocks.en: For potential impact, we use BERTScore F1, cosine similarity, and chrF++, following Hop 6. GPT-5.2 achieves the highest scores on all three metrics. Across models, BERTScore and cosine similarity exceed chrF++, suggesting that generated statements capture the semantic content of the reference annotations despite lexical differences. Finally, in response to RQ1, severity prediction exhibits lower classification performance than initial content triage in Hop 1. Although both tasks involve four-class classification, Hop 7 requires a more fine-grained assessment of harmful content, suggesting that severity prediction is more challenging and supporting the broader observation that performance can decline as the benchmark progresses toward more complex reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 对于潜在影响,我们使用BERTScore F1,同位素相似性,和chrF++,跟随Hop 6. GPT-5.2在所有三个度量衡上都取得了最高分. 在整个模型中,BERTScore和同位素相似性超过chrF++,暗示生成的语句可以捕捉参考说明的语义内容,尽管有词法差异. 最后,针对RQ1,严重程度预测显示在Hop 1中分类性能低于初始内容分解. 虽然这两项任务都涉及四等分级,但Hop 7要求对有害内容进行更精细的评估,表明严重程度预测更具挑战性,并支持更广泛的观点,即随着基准向更复杂的推理任务迈进,性能可能会下降.

blocks.en: Table 4: LLM performance on hate speech severity (multi-hop and one-shot) and potential impact. All metrics are reported on a 0–100 scale, except for weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa .
blocks.zh: 表4:关于仇恨言论严重程度的LLM性能(多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹少弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹多弹等潜在影响。 所有度量衡都按0-100的比例报告,但加权的Cohen ob-kappa除外。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Conditional probability distribution of identity bases given the presence of each moral foundation.
blocks.zh: 图2:鉴于每个道德基础的存在,特征基础的有条件概率分布.

blocks.en: 4.2 Correlation Analysis Across Reasoning Hops
blocks.zh: 4.2 跨理性跳跃的关联性分析

blocks.en: To investigate which hate speech tactics in Persian are most strongly associated with higher severity levels ( RQ4 ), we calculate the conditional probability of each severity level given the presence of a specific hate speech tactic in the reference data. Figure 3 shows the resulting distributions and reveals a clear relationship between the type of tactic and severity. Incitement to Violence or Harm is most strongly associated with the severe category (70%), followed by Calls for Discrimination or Exclusion (51%). Dehumanization also tends to occur at higher severity levels, with most instances falling into the medium or severe categories. In contrast, Harmful Stereotyping and Conspiracy Theories are predominantly associated with lower severity categories.
blocks.zh: 为了调查波斯语中哪些仇恨言论策略与更严重程度(RQ4)关系最密切,我们根据参考数据中是否存在具体的仇恨言论策略来计算每个严重程度的有条件概率. 图3显示由此产生的分布,并显示战术类型和严重程度之间的明确关系。 煽动暴力或伤害与严重类别(70%)关系最密切,其次是呼吁歧视或排斥(51%)。 非人化现象也往往发生在更严重的程度,大多数情况属于中等或严重类别。 相形之下,有害的定型和阴谋论主要与轻度类别有关.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Conditional probability distribution of severity levels given the presence of each hate speech tactic.
blocks.zh: 图3:鉴于每一种仇恨言论策略的存在,严重程度的有条件概率分布。

blocks.en: To assess whether the observed differences are statistically significant, we conduct a chi-square test of independence separately for each tactic and apply Benjamini–Hochberg correction for multiple comparisons. The results, shown in Appendix E , indicate significant associations between severity and five of the six tactics, with Conspiracy Theories being the only exception. Incitement to Violence or Harm shows the strongest association by far, followed by Slurs/Derogatory Language and Calls for Discrimination or Exclusion . This pattern is consistent with the distinction between direct and indirect forms of hateful expression, as conspiracy theories may operate more indirectly than tactics involving explicit harm, violence, or exclusion Bilewicz (2024) .
blocks.zh: 为了评估观察到的差异在统计学上是否具有重大意义,我们对每种战术分别进行独立度的千分之一测试,并对Benjamini-Hochberg的多重比较进行校正. 附录E显示的结果表明,在6个战术中,严重性和5个战术之间存在重大联系,阴谋论是唯一例外。 煽动暴力或伤害行为是迄今为止最强烈的联系,其次是Slurs/Deamiate Language和要求歧视或排斥。 这种模式符合直接和间接形式的仇恨言论的区别,因为阴谋论可能比涉及明显伤害、暴力或排斥Bilewicz(2024年)的策略更间接地运作。

blocks.en: We analyze co-occurrence patterns between moral foundations and identity bases to examine how identity-targeted hate speech is morally framed. Using the reference annotations, we compute the conditional distribution of identity bases for each moral foundation, excluding identity bases with fewer than 20 occurrences to reduce the influence of sparse categories. Figure 2 presents the resulting distributions. Political Affiliation has high conditional probabilities across several moral foundations, with its strongest association with Subversion , indicating that attacks targeting political affiliation are particularly likely to involve subversion-based moral framing. Organizational/Institutional Affiliation and Occupation/Profession also co-occur substantially with multiple moral foundations, highlighting the prominence of institutional and occupational identities in morally framed hate narratives. Less frequent identity bases show more limited and variable associations, which should be interpreted cautiously given their lower support.
blocks.zh: 我们分析道德基础和身份基础之间的共同模式,以审查以身份为目标的仇恨言论在道德上如何构成。 使用参考说明,我们计算每个道德基础的身份基础的有条件分布,不包括出现不到20起的身份基础,以减少稀有类别的影响. 图2列出了由此产生的分布情况。 政治附属组织在若干道德基础上具有很高的有条件概率,它与Subversion的关系最密切,这表明针对政治派别的攻击特别可能涉及以颠覆为基础的道德框架。 组织/机构附属和职业/职业也在很大程度上与多重道德基础相通,突出了机构和职业身份在道德上形成的仇恨叙事中的突出地位。 不太频繁的身份基础显示联系比较有限和多变,鉴于其支持程度较低,应谨慎解释。

blocks.en: To test whether these patterns reflect systematic associations rather than differences in marginal frequencies, we conduct pairwise χ 2 \chi^{2} tests of independence using instance-level presence/absence indicators. We apply the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure to control the false discovery rate and report Cramér’s V V as the effect size. Several associations remain significant after correction, with the strongest effects for Harm and Personal Identity ( V = 0.281 V=0.281 ), Harm and Organizational/Institutional Affiliation ( V = 0.273 V=0.273 ), and Betrayal and Political Affiliation ( V = 0.271 V=0.271 ). These results support the co-occurrence patterns observed in Figure 2 . The complete set of significant associations is reported in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 为了检验这些模式是否反映系统性关联而不是边缘频率的差异,我们利用实例层面的存在/缺失指标,对独立性进行双向测试。 Benjamini-Hochberg程序控制假发现率, 一些协会在矫正后仍然具有重大意义,其影响最强的是伤害和个人身份(V=0.281 V=0.281)、伤害和组织/机构附属(V=0.273 V=0.273)以及背叛和政治附属(V=0.271 V=0.271 V=0.271)。 这些结果支持了图2所观察到的共同发生率模式。 附录F报告了一整套重要协会。

blocks.en: To further examine differences in LLMs’ ability to identify specific targeted groups, we analyze recall across the 12 standardized categories. Figure 4 presents the results. Migrants & Ethnic/Religious Minorities is among the most consistently well-detected categories, with recall exceeding 80% for Grok, GPT-5.2, o3, Claude, and DeepSeek R1. In contrast, Human Rights, Media & Academic Activists is consistently challenging, with recall below 61% for every model and below 50% for all open-weight models. Other categories, including Iranian Women , Iranian Men , and Companies, Organizations, & Their Employees , achieve relatively high recall for several models, although performance varies across model families. Reasoning variants generally improve recall: Qwen3 Think substantially outperforms Qwen3 Instruct on most target groups, while DeepSeek R1 generally outperforms DeepSeek V3, though not uniformly. Overall, performance varies considerably across target groups, with some categories consistently more challenging and reasoning-oriented models often providing broader coverage.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we proposed a fine-grained multi-hop benchmark for analyzing Persian hate speech through increasingly complex reasoning steps. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs reveals substantial variation in performance across stages, with performance generally declining as tasks require more fine-grained semantic and inferential reasoning. Proprietary models generally outperform open-weight models, while the benefits of reasoning-oriented models vary across tasks. Our ablation study shows that intermediate analyses improve macro F1 for five of eight models, while weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa improves for all models, suggesting more consistent gains in ordinal agreement than in classification performance. Beyond model performance, our analyses uncover meaningful structure in Persian hate speech: Incitement to Violence or Harm exhibits the strongest association with higher severity levels, while political-affiliation targets are particularly associated with subversion-based moral framing. Uneven performance across target groups also highlights differences in LLMs’ sensitivity to hate speech directed at distinct social categories. Together, these findings demonstrate the challenges of reliable and interpretable LLM-based hate speech analysis and the value of modeling the underlying structure of harmful discourse, providing guidance for more effective and culturally informed moderation systems for Persian-language social media.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个精细的多跳基准,通过越来越复杂的推理步骤来分析波斯仇恨言论. 我们对最先进的法学硕士的评价显示,各阶段的业绩差别很大,业绩普遍下降,因为任务需要更精细的语义推理。 专有模型一般优于开量模型,而以推理为导向的模型的好处则因任务而异. 我们的通缩研究显示,中间分析可以改善8个模型中的5个模型的宏F1,而加权Cohen的ob \kappa可以改善所有模型,这表明在平分一致方面比在分类性能方面更加一致。 我们的分析发现波斯仇恨言论中有意义的结构: 煽动暴力或伤害表现得最强烈,其严重程度更高,而政治附属目标则特别与以颠覆为基础的道德框架有关。 不同目标群体的不均匀表现也凸显了LLMs对针对不同社会类别的仇恨言论的敏感度的差异. 这些调查结果共同显示了基于LLM的可靠和可解释的仇恨言论分析的挑战,以及模拟有害言论的基本结构的价值,为波斯语社交媒体提供更有效和文化上知情的温和系统的指导。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations that could be addressed in future work. We focus exclusively on hate speech in Persian and content from X and Instagram; extending our framework to other languages and platforms could provide a more comprehensive assessment of LLM performance and generalizability. Additionally, our benchmark is balanced across the four initial content-triage categories rather than reflecting their natural distribution on social media. Consequently, it may not represent the prevalence of different types of content in real-world settings. Future work could evaluate the framework on randomly sampled social media data to better reflect real-world distributions. Finally, the relatively small benchmark size may limit coverage of less frequent target groups, identity bases, and hate tactics. Larger and more diverse benchmarks could therefore provide broader coverage of these categories and enable more robust evaluation of model performance.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有一些局限性,可以在今后的工作中加以解决。 我们只关注波斯语的仇恨言论以及来自X和Instagram的内容;将我们的框架扩大到其他语言和平台,可以对LLM的性能和通俗性进行更全面的评估. 此外,我们的基准在最初的四个内容检索类别之间是平衡的,而不是反映其在社交媒体上的自然分布。 因此,它可能不代表现实世界环境中不同类型内容的普遍性。 今后的工作可以对随机抽取的社交媒体数据框架进行评估,以更好地反映现实世界的分布情况。 最后,基准规模相对较小,可能限制对频率较低的目标群体、身份基础和仇恨策略的覆盖。 因此,更大和更多样化的基准可以扩大这些类别的范围,并能够更有力地评价示范业绩。
